[[Kayala Fei]]'s '''co-anchor''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] working for [[BAMR News]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] struck at Kayala Fei, who was secretly a [[Sith Saber]] in disguise, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Octa Ramis]] ordered the co-anchor to continue broadcasting.
